_meta.purpose: The REAL captured trade-call snapshot baked (STATIC) into the landing verdict card. Same DEMONSTRATIVE-FROM-REAL-EVENT framing as its predecessor: ships behind an explicit "Example output" label, never implies a live tradable signal. verdict/conviction/regime/factors/Why are STATIC from this capture; the Proof-line PFE WR + N stay LIVE-bound via data-tr-field (pfe_wr/call_count) and never come from this file. The capture timestamp is deliberately NOT rendered on the card face — timestamps age.
_meta.why_the_asset_changed: The 06-20 AXS capture recorded `funding_state: ELEVATED` but NOT the underlying `funding_rate`. This wave's `reasoning` cites the measured rate, so the AXS card was not re-renderable without inventing a figure — and an invented number in public copy is a numerical-citation violation regardless of how plausible it looks. This XRP call is the one the wave was opened over (Mr.1's card), measured live 2026-08-06 on BINANCE 1h with the full indicator set, so every figure on the card traces to a real reading. `funding_rate` is recorded here precisely so the NEXT wave never faces this choice.
_meta.ratification_still_satisfied: Q-P2-3 required a real BUY/SELL at conviction >= 60% (the track-record qualifying threshold). XRP BUY at 62% clears it.

example_call.reasoning: Funding at -0.0066% is unusually negative for XRP over 14 days: shorts pay longs → bullish. Regime is ranging with no trend structure to lean on and open interest is +2.4% over 24h, context only and not a verdict input. Flips to HOLD if funding normalises.
